description: This file defines an Android activity called DevRewindPlaybackActivity which simulates rewinding content and relaunches the playback activity with an intent containing a content ID.

classes.name: DevRewindPlaybackActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that simulates rewinding content and relaunches the PlaybackActivity with a specified content ID.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity is starting. It retrieves a content ID from the intent or defaults to 'prototype_1', then launches PlaybackActivity with that ID.
